meta.title: Markdown editor
meta.description: Browse the Markdown files of a workspace, edit them with a live preview, and save in place. Open it from the Markdown editor icon in the left sidebar. It also adds a "Markdown edit" viewer to right-Sidebar document tabs, beside Markdown, Code, and Plain text. Saves go through the deployment's file policy, so read-only mode refuses them; creating files only works inside registered workspace folders that already exist.
